GUIDE / FIRST STEPS

Getting started.

Six steps to get started with your group.

  1. Open 21Life and create your account

    Use the web app or install Android. Sign in with email and password, or with Google in the standard edition.

  2. Create or join your playgroup

    Bring your group together in a private space. Invite members and add guests to games without requiring an account.

  3. Add your decks

    Add the decks you play or import them from Archidekt or Moxfield. Check commanders and colour identity before the game.

  4. Set up the table

    In the game wizard, select players, decks, starting life and layout. The table supports 2–6 players.

  5. Play and record the result

    Manage life, damage and eliminations. Record the winner and win condition, or a draw. The result feeds your history and statistics.

  6. Check your statistics

    Explore group rankings, deck performance and awards. Use filters to compare relevant games and brackets.

BEFORE YOU START

An internet connection is required

Accounts, syncing and deck imports require internet. If a game is interrupted, reopen the app to resume it.

MOXFIELD / ARCHIDEKT

Already have a list?
Import your deck.

You do not need to recreate decks you already have on Moxfield or Archidekt. Import them into your 21Life profile and use them in your games.

  1. Copy the deck link

    Open the list on the source service and copy its URL.

  2. Open your decks

    In your 21Life profile, choose import and paste the link.

  3. Review and save

    Review the imported deck before using it in a game. Your original list stays unchanged; internet and access to the list are required.
